records.purpose: F01: observe pending or genuinely attempted debounced save; stop Linux wrapper descendants on phase abort; F02: KK-only live 300s warning and 600s hang protection
records.level: Existing native information mode and phase runner; one bounded Python process-tree regression, no new native mode or images; deterministic clock/wait controls and one short real KK descendant cleanup case
records.coverage: Existing 93 information checks retained with stronger causal timer assertion and one clean-start check. One Linux timeout test covers child/grandchild termination and unrelated-process isolation. Native command arguments and all save budgets unchanged; F02 replaces only the KK process limit as explicitly authorized. Targeted diagnostic traces remain local, outside permanent CI. F01-D03 also exposes the unchanged drawing-capture command at the executable reader; positional caller and arguments remain identical. The same process-tree test covers procfs disappearance at open (ENOENT) and read (ESRCH), while permission errors still fail; no liveness assertion is relaxed. F02 adds six cheap tests: KK before warning, successful 301/599s completion with live flushed warning, preserved exit/marker/engine-error rejection, hard timeout at 600s, unchanged other caller budgets, and real Linux descendant cleanup with accelerated waits. No new native mode, frames, assertions or artifact class. Decision: https://github.com/venomenon328/picross/pull/506#issuecomment-6631521834 . The longer KK ceiling is not an estimate of added mandatory work; actual CI runtime remains separately measured in T01. P2-C transfers the two subsequently changed shared source paths into its own delta record; the historical F01/F02 assertions and budgets remain unchanged.

Cost is conservative additional small guards/report metadata, not a new heavy native workload. Local diagnostics are one-off, not CI obligations; full final CI and temporary remainder belong in T01.
